sanskrit: yad apsu te sarasvati goṣv aśveṣu yan madhu | tena no vājinīvati mukham aṅdhi sarasvati varcasā ||
english: Whatever sweetness is yours, O Sarasvatī, in the waters, in the cows, in the horses — with that, O Vājinīvatī, anoint our faces with radiant splendour, O Sarasvatī.

sanskrit: yo adya deva sūrya tvāṃ ca māṃ cāntarāyati | tasmin duṣvapnyaṃ sarvaṃ duritāni ca mṛjmahe ||
english: O divine Sun, whoever stands between you and me today — onto him we wipe away all evil dreams and all misfortunes.

sanskrit: yo no +'bhicchāyaṃ martyeṣv agniṃ tiṣṭhasy antarā | tasya vṛścāmi te mūlaṃ na cchāyāṃ karavo 'param ||
english: You who stand between our shadow among mortals and the fire — I cut away your root; no further shadow shall these hands of his make.

sanskrit: ghnantv enaṃ deveṣavo brahmāṇo ghnantu menyā | yo asmākaṃ prajāpate agniṃ tiṣṭhaty antarā ||
english: Let the divine arrows strike him, let the Brahmaṇas strike him with wrath — him who, O Prajāpati, stands between us and the fire.

sanskrit: prajāpate yo 'smām̐ ādṛś- -āgniṃ tiṣṭhaty antarā | taṃ mṛtyave pra yacchāmi sa rudrasyāstv ākhaṇaḥ ||
english: O Prajāpati, him who, having looked upon us, stands between us and the fire — I hand him over to Death; may he be Rudra's target.

sanskrit: pra suvainaṃ devavajrebhyo mṛtyur vi kramatām adhi | sinātv enān nirṛtir mṛtyoḥ pāśair bandhair avimokyaiḥ ||
english: Drive him forth to the divine thunderbolts; may Death stride over him. May Nirṛti bind them with the nooses of Death, with bonds from which there is no release.

sanskrit: sumaṅgalena vacasā keśin grāmaṃ na ā vada | brahmaṇābrahmaṇā tv- -olūkācchā vadāmasi ||
english: O long-haired one, do not address the village with auspicious speech. We speak to you, O owl, with the formula of the brahman-non-brahman.

sanskrit: parāṅ eva parā vada parācīm anu saṃvatam | yathā yamasya tvā gṛhe 'rasaṃ praticākaśaṃ niyastaṃ praticākaśam ||
english: Speak only away, speak away, following the westward-facing year, as if in Yama's house, sapless, staring out, lodged there, staring out.

sanskrit: śunam ulūka no vada yaṃ dviṣmas tam ito naya | rājño yamasya te gṛhe sikatābhir videvyam ākhus te mūṣiked bhāgaḥ ||
english: Cry out favourably to us, O owl, and lead away from here the one we hate. In the house of King Yama, your gaming with sand shall be your portion, and a mouse shall nibble it away.

sanskrit: ā vada bahulaṃ goṣṭhaṃ dhītavatsam anaṣṭagum | dhvāṅkṣāya dvipadāṃ vada śune catuṣpadāṃ vada ||
english: Speak of the plentiful cow-pen, the calf-seeking cow, the cow not lost. Speak of two-footed beings to the crow; speak of four-footed beings to the dog.

sanskrit: punar me rājā varuṇaḥ punar indraḥ punar bhagaḥ | punar me viśve devā āyur jīvitavā aduḥ ||
english: May King Varuṇa give back to me again, may Indra give back again, may Bhaga give back again; may all the gods give back to me again life and the means of living.

sanskrit: ut tiṣṭhātaḥ pra dravārvāṅ mātra tiṣṭho 'bhicākaśat | sapatnyā varca ādāy- -āthāsmābhiḥ sahāsasi ||
english: Rise up, run forward toward us; do not stand gazing here. Having taken the radiance away from the rival wife, then you shall be together with us.

sanskrit: ut tiṣṭhata nir dravata na va ihāsti nyañcanam | amuṣya vittam abhi vaḥ suvāmi tad anuvadhvaṃ sudatīr ahinas tat ||
english: Rise up, run out; there is no descending for you here. I press toward you the wealth of that man yonder — follow it, O fair-toothed ones; the serpent has shed that.

sanskrit: ye asmākaṃ sabandhavo viṣṭhitāḥ pṛthivīm anu | teṣām indra iva devānām ahaṃ bhūyāsam uttamaḥ ||
english: Among those kinsmen of ours who are dispersed across the earth, may I be the highest among them, as Indra is among the gods.

sanskrit: ye agnayaḥ pārthivā āhitāḥ pṛthivīm anu | teṣām asi tvaṃ saṃgathe sa no jīvātave kṛdhi ||
english: Among the earthly fires that have been kindled across the earth, you are their meeting-place; make us live.

sanskrit: cita stha paricita sth- -āgnayaś ca nihavā nāma | te no mā ni hvadhvaṃ tebhyo vo namo na vo havam emi | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ sa vo havam etu ||
english: You are piled up, you are piled all around; and the fires are called 'Nihava' by name. Do not call us down; homage to you — I do not come to your summons. Let him who hates us and whom we hate come to your summons.

sanskrit: indrāgnī punar ā kṛtaṃ na etā sthiravīrāv aparāvītagū | asmākaṃ sarvā nihave santv eṣāṃ vayaṃ vidyāma guhyaṃ nāma gavām ||
english: O Indra and Agni, restore these two to us; these two are firm-heroed ones whose cows do not wander away. May all of them be at our Nihava-call; may we know the secret name of the cows of those.

sanskrit: prajāpate anunikrandaya viśve devāḥ padavāyāḥ santv āsām | ādityā anusaṃgatya śūrā indrajyeṣṭhāḥ punar ā vartayantu ||
english: O Prajāpati, roar after them; may all the gods become trackers of their path. May the Ādityas, heroes gathered together, those for whom Indra is chief, turn them back again.

sanskrit: indra praṇetar vardhaya m- -āśvinā māṃ vahatam āśvaśvā | aindrāgnaṃ varma pratimuñcamāno yathobhayebhyaś cāru samitim ā vadāni ||
english: O Indra, leader, increase me; O Aśvins swift as horses, carry me forward. Putting on the armour of Indra and Agni, may I speak the pleasing assembly-call for both sides.

sanskrit: cāruvāk cāruvadanaś cāru saṃ kāśa no nṛbhiḥ | adveṣyapratīkāśo jigīvām̐ aparājitaḥ ||
english: Sweet of speech, sweet of face, appear sweetly to us among men — one whose countenance is free of hatred, victorious, unconquered.

sanskrit: api vṛśca purāṇavad vratater iva guṣpitam | ojo dāsasya jambhaya yad etad asya saṃbhṛtaṃ madhu tad indrasya vibhajāvahai ||
english: Cut away, as of old, like the tangled growth of a creeper; crush the vigour of the Dāsa. Let us share out between us this honey he has gathered — let it be Indra's.

sanskrit: mlāpayāmi vrajaḥ śubhraṃ varuṇasya vratena te | yathā śepoapāyy asa strīṣu cāso anāvayāḥ ||
english: I wilt your bright manly power by the ordinance of Varuṇa, so that your phallus falls away and you are incapable before women.

sanskrit: avasthasya kladīvato bhaṅgurasya nitodinaḥ | yad uttatam ava tat tanu yad ātataṃ ni tat tanu ||
english: Of the impotent, the eunuch, the brittle, the stinging one — that which is stretched up, draw it down; that which is stretched taut, flatten it down.

sanskrit: amimlapaṃ te tanvaṃ klībaṃ tvā vīrudhākaram | antaḥkośa iva kośeṣu strīṣv apyākṛtaś cara ||
english: I have wilted your body; I have made you impotent by means of this plant. Like an inner sheath among sheaths, go among women as one whose form is withdrawn within.

sanskrit: ā no medaṃ gṛhapatir dadhātv indreṇa medinā | ā no medaṃ sarasvaty ā no vahantu sindhavaḥ ||
english: May the householder bestow fat upon us together with Indra the fat-giving one; may Sarasvatī bring fat to us; may the rivers carry fat to us.

sanskrit: medaṃ dhātā medaṃ pūṣā medam indro dadhātu me | medaṃ me aśvinobh- -ā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
english: May Dhātṛ bestow fat upon me, may Pūṣan bestow fat, may Indra bestow fat on me; may both Aśvins garlanded with blue lotus bestow fat upon me.

sanskrit: ūrū medaya me bāhū aṣṭhīvantā uraś ca me | vapāṃ pary asya udare medam indro dadhātu me ||
english: Fatten my thighs, my arms, my knee-joints and my chest; may Indra bestow fat upon me, along with the omentum around the belly of this one.

sanskrit: carmaṇa ivopanītasya sarvān keśān vṛhāmi te | ayaspātram iva te śiro yathāsat samaraṃ samam ||
english: Like the hair of a hide brought near for dressing, I pluck out all your hair, so that your head may be even and level like an iron bowl.
